coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Z is the central bore and gear rotation axis. Section A-A notes place the section-view horizontal axis along Z and radial directions in X/Y. Axial end faces are normal to Z; gear teeth and bore are concentric about this axis.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: Datum A is defined by the central internal bore cylindrical surface and establishes the gear rotation axis. Side-face runout controls and the gear-data radial runout reference datum A.

component_spec_links.link_notes: The helical gear table describes the external gear tooth zone: tooth count, module, helix angle, gear tolerances, and radial runout. It matches the tooth profile, tooth tip detail, axial gear envelope/face-width section, and tooth-flank crowning diagrams. Bore chamfers, tapers, end-face grooves, and datum bore are not the primary gear-spec zone.

assumptions.text: Grouped section_aa:F1 with section_view_bb:F1 because Section B-B is described as passing radially through the gear body and both observations define the axial external gear envelope/face-width zone. section_aa:F1 was made canonical because it carries the toleranced width and external/root-cylinder diameter.

Grouped section_cc:F1 with detail_y:F1 because the parent tooth-profile section has a Detail Y callout at the gear tooth tip and Detail Y enlarges that tooth-tip/chamfer region. section_cc:F1 was made canonical because it contains the broader tooth-profile geometry.

Grouped involute_crowning:F1 with longitudinal_crowning:F1 as two evaluation diagrams for the same physical gear tooth flank/mating surface. involute_crowning:F1 was made canonical because it contains more explicit profile/path diameter callouts.

Did not group detail_z:F1 with section_aa:F5 despite the nearby Detail Z callout on the bore-end chamfer observation, because Detail Z describes R0.8 shallow concentric end-face grooves with diameters around the gear face, while section_aa:F5 is a 20 degree central-bore chamfer. Treating them as one feature would merge incompatible geometry.

Left isometric_view:F1 as a singleton visualization feature because it is an overall part-body view with no feature-level dimensions and would otherwise over-group the bore, teeth, and body into one node.

Linked gear_data_table to the external gear tooth/profile and crowning feature observations because the table title and parameters describe the helical gear teeth, not the central bore or end-face groove features.

Used the gear-data radial runout entry referenced to datum A as relationship evidence from the gear tooth profile to the datum bore, even though the runout value is stored in the component specification table rather than as a section-level GD&T control.
The cylindricity control over LENGTH B applies exclusively to the straight main central bore surface and excludes the 10-degree bore end taper.
